loginSubtitle: Enter the username and password of your account.
firstTimeHint: First time here? Register with the mobile number the school has on file — you are asked only once.
registerHint: Your mobile number is asked once so we can identify you, then you create a username and password to sign in with later.
enterLinkedPhone: Enter the mobile number linked to your children
usernameRule: Lowercase English letters and digits only — capitals and symbols are not allowed.
passwordRule: English letters and digits only — no symbols, and at least 8 characters.
confirmPasswordRule: Retype the same password to confirm.
selectStudentSubtitle: Choose the student whose records you want to see.
missingChildHint: Cannot find one of your children? Ask the school to link the student record to your mobile number.
forgotSubtitle: Enter the mobile number registered with the school and we will send you a password reset link by text message.
linkSentTo: We sent the password reset link to
linkValidity: The link is valid for 30 minutes and cannot be used more than once.
openLink: Open the link and update the password
updatePasswordSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account — you will sign in with it from now on.
passwordAdvice: Use at least 8 characters with one digit.
attendanceLogHint: Consecutive absence days are grouped into one period, and a single excuse covers them all.
submitExcuseForPeriod: Submit an excuse for this period
coveredDaysHint: The days below are consecutive; you may send one excuse covering them all, or leave a day out.
gapWarning: You left out a day in the middle of the period — the excuse will be recorded for the selected days only, and the excluded day stays without an excuse.
excuseNoteHint: Write the details of the excuse…
excuseReviewHint: The administration reviews the excuse within one working day and you are notified of the result.
excuseSent: The excuse was sent and is now under review.
subject: Subject
healthPrivacy: This information is shown to the school health counsellor only, and is used in emergencies.
schoolInstructions: Details and instructions for the school
healthInstructionsHint: For example: uses an inhaler during an asthma attack, and is excused from strenuous physical lessons.
examsHint: Tap any date to see the details written by the teacher.
actionsHint: An action is issued when a note is recorded against the student, and escalates as the note repeats. Most actions only require you to read them.
phoneIsIdentifier: The mobile number is your account identifier with the school; changing it requires a verification code.
passwordAdviceLong: Use at least 8 characters with one digit, and avoid a password you use elsewhere.
alertPreview: How the alert looks on your device
alertsKeptHint: Whatever you switch off is still recorded in the app — it only stops arriving as a device alert.
languageHint: The language changes across the whole app immediately.
supportScope: For technical problems in the app only. For anything about your child's records, contact the school.
shareSubtitle: Share the app with other parents so they can follow their children too.
shareIconsHint: Tapping any of them opens your device's own share sheet.
deleteAccountBody1: Your account will be disconnected from your children's records, and you will no longer receive any notification about them.
deleteAccountBody2: Your children's records stay with their school, because they are the school's records — deleting your account does not delete them.
deleteRequested: The account deletion request was sent.
